comments.author: pinkwar
comments.body: People already get it after the 1000th post. With these tools anyone can throw together a game. It’s a prompt away. So why would someone play your game? That’s the only question that matters. Shift from tech to player value. Code, tools, even whole games go obsolete fast. Success is about distinctiveness and longevity, not the stack. The hard part is getting people to actually play. Design, loop, narrative, how you communicate the experience. Nail that or it’s just another soulless demo.
